mapper.select:
SELECT r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , r.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,1,6) AS BIRTH_DATE
,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,7,1) IN ('1','2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,1,2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,7,1) IN ('3','4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,1,2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE
,CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,7,1)),2) =1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER
, TO_CHAR(r.TREATMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS TREATMENT_DATE , mr.DIAGNOSIS_NAME , TO_CHAR(mr.START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RECORD_START_DATE FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER JOIN MEDICAL_RECORD mr ON r.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = mr.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE r.TREATMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND r.TREATMENT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND r.TREATMENT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') +1
AND (m.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,1,6) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY r.TREATMENT_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER SET MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = #{medicalRecordNumber}, REGISTER_S = #{registerS}, REGISTER_O = #{registerO}, REGISTER_A = #{registerA}, REGISTER_P = #{registerP}, RECEIPT_STATUS = '진료완료', TREATMENT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber}
UPDATE RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER SET RECEIPT_STATUS = '진료중' WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND RECEIPT_STATUS = '호출중'
mapper.select:
SELECT r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE
, CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER
, TO_CHAR(r.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS RECEIPT_DATE
, r.RECEIPT_STATUS AS RECEIPT_STATUS
, latest.DIAGNOSIS_NAME
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mr1.MEMBER_NUMBER, mr1.DIAGNOSIS_NAME FROM MEDICAL_RECORD mr1 WHERE mr1.START_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(mr2.START_DATE) FROM MEDICAL_RECORD mr2 WHERE mr2.MEMBER_NUMBER = mr1.MEMBER_NUMBER ) ) latest ON latest.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE r.RECEIPT_STATUS IN ('호출중', '진료중')
AND r.DOCTOR_NUMBER = #{doctorNumber}
ORDER BY CASE r.RECEIPT_STATUS WHEN '진료중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.RECEIPT_DATE ASC

SELECT MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER , DIAGNOSIS_NAME , TO_CHAR(MEDICAL_RECORD.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_DATE , RECORD_STATUS FROM MEDICAL_RECORD WHERE MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber} ORDER BY MEDICAL_RECORD.START_DATE DESC

SELECT MEDICAL_NUMBER , TO_CHAR(TREATMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS TREATMENT_DATE , REGISTER_S , REGISTER_O , REGISTER_A , REGISTER_P FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = #{medicalRecordNumber} ORDER BY TREATMENT_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT me.MEDICINE_CODE , nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , me.SPECIFICATION , me.UNIT , unitCode.CODENAME_1 AS UNIT_LABEL , me.UNIT_COST FROM MEDICINE me JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = me.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' JOIN COMMONCODE unitCode ON unitCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = me.UNIT AND unitCode.COMMONCODE = 'U' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE routeCode ON routeCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = me.MEDICINE_CATEGORY AND routeCode.COMMONCODE = 'C' WHERE nameCode.CODENAME_1 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND routeCode.CODENAME_2 = '주사'
AND NVL(routeCode.CODENAME_2, '경구') != '주사'
ORDER BY nameCode.CODENAME_1 ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COMMONCODE_NUMBER AS COMMON_CODE_NUMBER , CODENAME_1 , CODENAME_2 , UNIT_PRICE FROM COMMONCODE WHERE COMMONCODE = 'P' AND USED = 'Y' AND CODENAME_1 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY CODENAME_1 ASC )WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
